why_the_qwen_brain_repo_is_off_limits: brief-8 publishes repository-wide test figures for /Users/gl/projects/xh-202607-qwen-brain. Adding code there before the 2026-09-03 freeze would drift those published numbers. The repo must stay byte-stable through the freeze.

tzb_fe_notes_for_phase_0.note: The probe's purpose is to measure whether the frozen Qwen3.8-27B — which is already multimodal and already served — can point. Any 3B/4B pointing model must beat it on the same scale before it earns a slot. The adoption rule is beat-incumbent, not newer-paper.

Simulator ground truth may be used for SCORING only. It must never enter test-time policy input. P3 was cancelled for crossing this line. The probe design must separate the two explicitly, not by convention.

The object-table benchmark has no owner and is not being built. Without it there is no shared scale on which beat-incumbent can be decided. PR-Bench (released separately from Motto) may cover part of this. State plainly in the draft if the probe cannot be scored for lack of a scale — that is a finding, not a failure.

The frozen visual family is defective: expected answers require emitting an opaque internal ID (s5_track_...) absent from the input, so 0/12 is a task defect, not a capability result. That data cannot be reused as pointing supervision. Isaac carries GT pose and could be converted, but that conversion is its own engineering line.

Numbers carry test medium, conditions, and unsupported extrapolations. 'We did not verify X' must never be written as 'X is unverifiable'. A single observation never supports a universal claim. mtime is not byte evidence; probability is not verification. Declaring work complete requires one completely-returned scan, not an absence of visible errors.

decision_criteria_in_order: 1. beat the incumbent — can the frozen 27B, already multimodal and already served, point? Nothing can be selected against no baseline.
2. visual-prompt path — 'box one example, find the rest' is the industrial new-SKU action and the few-shot adaptation story
3. domestic reachability — the test machine cannot reach overseas hosts
4. license terms — read and record; probability is not verification
why_visual_prompt_matters_here: Show one sample part, find all like it. That is literally what happens when a new SKU arrives on a line. A model without that path can still do text-prompted detection, but it cannot do the few-shot adaptation story.
